exposure: history of one previous Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS)
cohort: The study included 200 postpartum individuals, divided into two groups: 100 without a history of LSCS and 100 with one previous LSCS.
finding: The study found no statistically significant association between a history of one previous LSCS and an increased risk of Postpartum hemorrhage (PPH).
mod_finding: Individuals with a single prior LSCS had comparable PPH risks to those without, suggesting no significant association between previous LSCS and PPH incidence.
